notes:
Summary: Mid-market analytics/SaaS vendor exploring Redwood Hosted API for chat & embeddings during Q4 trial; now shifting to Dedicated evaluation for predictable latency and cost. Short version bullets from AE/SE/CSM notes:
- Hosted trial (Nov-Jan) completed: team tested chat flow (customer support bot + proactive NPS followups) and semantic search embeddings for product content.
- Observed trial metrics (sample week): avg QPS 22, 95th pctl latency 420ms for gen requests (avg response size ~120 tokens), median latency 230ms, tail spikes during 10-11am weekday: concurrency ~60. Embeddings calls ~18% of calls, 1536-d vectors. Avg tokens/day ~1.8M across all endpoints.
- Token mix: ~80% short-gen (50-200 tokens), ~18% embeddings, ~2% long-form summarization (500-2,000 tokens).
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget-conscious; prefer clear per-token and per-embedding unit economics + predictable reserved pricing. Finance asks for 12-month ARR forecast and burn delta vs current hosted spend.
- Initial ask: sizing worksheet + recommended Dedicated pool configuration to support sustained 80 QPS, bursts to 250 QPS, 60 concurrent model threads, and batching strategies to lower per-token cost. They want an answer both as "min viable dedicated" and "production-guardrail" configs.
- SE notes: recommend starting with 4 x A100-equivalent GPU pool (autoscale to 8) with continuous batching windows 20-50ms for chat, prefix cache enabled for common prompts, KV cache warmed for personalization use-cases. Expect this to cover 80 sustained QPS with comfortable headroom for 250 burst if autoscale triggers.
- Performance targets client cares about: p99 < 600ms for typical short responses, p95 < 350ms. They tested Redwood hosted latency baseline and liked predictability vs their current self-hosted.
- Security/compliance: require SSO (SAML + IdP), SOC2 evidence, audit logs retention settings, and KMS integration for key management. Want VPC peering for Dedicated; legal asked about data residency controls.
- Quotes / paraphrase: "We need predictable tails — spikes kill our support SLAs." — Head of Product. "If Dedicated reduces cost by 30% vs hosted at our scale, we can commit to reserved capacity." — Finance director.
- POC artifacts: attached trial metrics CSV, demo recording ff_2026-01-27_7801, pricing deck (drive link).
- Sales cadence: demo 2025-11-10 (intro), hosted trial start 2025-11-15, mid-trial checkpoint 2025-12-08, final trial review 2026-01-27, sizing request 2026-02-12, pricing discussion scheduled 2026-02-24.
- Current blockers: security team waiting on VPC peering diagram, finance needs a 12-month cost comparison (hosted vs dedicated reserved + ops), engineering needs CIDR and IAM docs for POC env.
- Next steps (short): send dedicated sizing proposal + 3-tier pricing (pilot, standard reserved, enterprise) by 2026-02-21, schedule 60-min pricing + security Q&A 2026-02-24.
Notes style: shorthand, bullets, links to artifacts, quotes, and explicit POC numbers for capacity planning.
